content_sections.heading: SAIL BSL Audiologist Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the SAIL BSL Audiologist walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Audiologist post at SAIL Bokaro General Hospital is scheduled for 19 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Audiologist position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a MASLP (Master in Audiology and Speech Language Pathology) or MSc (Speech & Hearing) degree to be eligible for the Audiologist role.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Audiologist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Audiologist position announced by SAIL Bokaro General Hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Audiologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Audiologist position is 69 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Audiologist role?
faq.answer: The salary is offered on a case-to-case basis, with specific rates for different audiological examinations and therapies, such as Audiometric Examination Rs.95 and B.E.R.A Rs.1400.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Audiologist position will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at SAIL Bokaro General Hospital, Bokaro, Jharkhand, with the pincode 827004.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job for the Audiologist position at SAIL Bokaro General Hospital is on a contractual basis.
